title.zh: 币安疑似遭黑客攻击，约56亿美元被盗

current_state.zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；币安联席 CEO Richard Teng 表示将在下周一前公布完整储备金证明，并有望在周日前恢复用户提现；攻击者利用 EIP-7702 获取热钱包链上执行授权，调查发现更多入侵点及自毁机制；币安已预留超过63.4亿美元公司资金覆盖损失，其中50亿美元为受影响同类代币，正通过市场和OTC渠道购入剩余部分，并与执法机构合作追回资产。
current_state.en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said a complete proof-of-reserves report will be released by Monday and user withdrawals are expected to resume by Sunday; attackers used EIP-7702 to obtain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, and additional breach points and self-destruct mechanisms were found. Binance has reserved over $6.34B in company funds to cover losses, including $5B in affected tokens, is buying the remainder through market and OTC channels, and is working with law enforcement to recover assets.

updates.title_zh: Binance黑客集群持仓监控：涉案65个币种总计58.75亿美元，其中25.4亿美元已被冻结
updates.title_en: Binance黑客集群持仓监控：涉案65个币种总计58.75亿美元，其中25.4亿美元已被冻结

updates.what_changed_en: Arkham data shows the Binance hacker cluster now holds about $5.875 billion across 65 tokens, and Binance says it has coordinated the freezing of about $2.54 billion in stolen funds.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance仍在调查该起黑客事件；黑客集群地址持有约58.75亿美元、65个币种资产，Binance称已联合冻结约25.4亿美元涉案资金。
updates.current_state_en: Binance is still investigating the hack; the hacker cluster holds about $5.875 billion across 65 tokens, and Binance says about $2.54 billion of the stolen funds has been frozen through coordination.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Arkham data shows the Binance hacker cluster now holds $5.875B across 65 tokens — led by $1.77B USDT, 18.27K BTC, 460.6K ETH, and $823M USDC — while Binance says it has coordinated the freezing of $2.54B of the stolen funds.

updates.title_zh: 【何一：Binance 暂停提币，直至确认环境安全，用户资金安全】
updates.title_en: 【何一：Binance 暂停提币，直至确认环境安全，用户资金安全】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安联合创始人何一表示，币安已暂停提币直至确认相关环境安全，并称用户资金安全（SAFU）；World Liberty Financial 协助冻结 2700 万美元 USD1 及 4800 万枚 WLFI（价值约 200 万美元）。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance co-founder Yi He said the exchange has paused withdrawals until it confirms the environment is secure, asserted user funds remain safe under SAFU, and thanked World Liberty Financial for helping freeze $27 million in USD1 plus 48 million WLFI tokens (worth about $2 million).

updates.current_state_en: Binance has paused withdrawals until it confirms the environment is secure; the hack remains under investigation, with Binance previously saying about $2.54 billion in stolen funds had been frozen through coordination, and World Liberty Financial helped freeze $27 million in USD1 plus 48 million WLFI tokens (about $2 million).
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance co-founder Yi He announced the exchange has halted withdrawals until it confirms its environment is secure, asserting user funds remain safe under SAFU and thanking World Liberty Financial for helping freeze $27 million in USD1 plus 48 million WLFI tokens.

updates.title_zh: 币安将63亿美元被盗事件归咎于工程师被入侵的笔记本电脑
updates.title_en: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance初步调查称，攻击者可能通过被入侵的DevOps工程师笔记本电脑进入服务容器并提交未经授权的提币交易，未发现私钥泄露证据；Binance将影响估计上调至约63亿美元，并称已冻结约30亿美元资产，计划用SAFU和公司资金覆盖损失、撤销受影响地址授权并更新储备证明。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance's preliminary investigation says attackers may have used a compromised DevOps engineer laptop to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence of private-key leakage; Binance raised the estimated impact to about $6.3 billion, said about $3 billion was frozen, and plans to cover losses via SAFU and company funds, revoke the affected address authorization, and publish updated Proof of Reserves.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance事件仍在调查中；初步指向DevOps设备被入侵和签名基础设施被滥用，而非私钥泄露。影响估计约63亿美元，约30亿美元已冻结，存取款曾暂停，受影响地址授权已撤销，损失将由SAFU和公司资金覆盖，详细技术复盘待发布。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance incident remains under investigation; preliminary findings point to a compromised DevOps device and signing-infrastructure misuse rather than private-key leakage. Estimated impact is about $6.3 billion, about $3 billion has been frozen, deposits/withdrawals were temporarily suspended, the affected address authorization was revoked, losses will be covered by SAFU and company funds, and a detailed technical post-mortem is pending.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance's preliminary investigation into its $6.3B breach points to a hacked DevOps engineer's laptop used to access internal infrastructure and push unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence found of a private-key leak.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance's preliminary investigation into its $6.3B breach points to a hacked DevOps engineer's laptop used to access internal infrastructure and push unauthorized withdrawal transactions, with no evidence found of a private-key leak.

updates.title_zh: Blockaid披露黑客如何控制币安钱包：50个EIP-7702账户之一
updates.title_en: Blockaid Reveals How Hacker Took Control of Binance Wallet: One of 50 EIP-7702 A
updates.what_changed_zh: Blockaid 分析披露攻击者通过单笔 Type-4 交易提交 50 个不同 nonce 的 EIP-7702 授权，仅一个匹配成功，将 Binance 14 热钱包委托给未经验证的恶意转账合约；该合约仅允许攻击者指定地址调用 sweep()，可转走 ETH 和 ERC-20 代币并保留 1 ETH 作为 gas。
updates.what_changed_en: Blockaid analysis disclosed that the attacker submitted 50 EIP-7702 authorizations with different nonces in a single Type-4 transaction; only one matched, delegating the Binance 14 hot wallet to an unverified malicious transfer contract. The contract only lets the attacker-designated address call sweep(), allowing ETH and ERC-20 tokens to be transferred while retaining 1 ETH for gas.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance 事件仍在调查中；此前初步指向 DevOps 设备被入侵和签名基础设施被滥用，影响估计约63亿美元，约30亿美元已冻结，存取款曾暂停，受影响地址授权已撤销，损失将由 SAFU 和公司资金覆盖。Blockaid 进一步分析称，攻击者利用 EIP-7702 授权机制，通过单笔交易提交 50 个不同 nonce 的授权，仅一个成功，使 Binance 14 热钱包被委托给恶意 sweep 合约。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance incident remains under investigation; preliminary findings pointed to a compromised DevOps device and signing-infrastructure misuse, with estimated impact about $6.3B, about $3B frozen, deposits/withdrawals temporarily suspended, the affected address authorization revoked, and losses to be covered by SAFU and company funds. Blockaid further analyzed that the attacker exploited EIP-7702 authorization by submitting 50 different-nonce authorizations in one transaction; only one succeeded, delegating the Binance 14 hot wallet to a malicious sweep contract.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Blockaid detailed how an attacker gained control of Binance's Binance 14 hot wallet by submitting 50 EIP-7702 authorizations with different nonces in a single Type-4 transaction, with the one matching authorization delegating the account to a malicious contract capable of sweeping ETH and ERC-20 tokens while leaving 1 ETH for gas.

updates.title_zh: 【1inch 封锁币安攻击者相关地址，但 1INCH 代币无法冻结】

updates.what_changed_en: Within one hour of the Binance hack, 1inch blocked attacker-associated addresses from its DApp, Wallet, and API and is sharing newly identified addresses with resolvers and integrators; however, because 1INCH is a standard ERC-20 token without freeze or blacklist functionality, stolen 1INCH tokens cannot be frozen.

updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; 1inch has blocked attacker-associated addresses but cannot freeze stolen 1INCH tokens; about $3B in assets has been frozen, deposits are operating normally, and withdrawals are paused with resumption expected within about 48 hours; analysts attribute the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor, some stolen funds were commingled with Bitget exploit funds, and losses will be covered by SAFU and company funds.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 1inch blocked attacker-associated addresses from its DApp, wallet, and API within an hour of the Binance hack and is sharing newly identified addresses with resolvers and integrators, but cannot freeze the stolen ERC-20 1INCH tokens because the token has no blacklist function.
updates.detailed_summary_en: 1inch blocked attacker-associated addresses from its DApp, wallet, and API within an hour of the Binance hack and is sharing newly identified addresses with resolvers and integrators, but cannot freeze the stolen ERC-20 1INCH tokens because the token has no blacklist function.

updates.title_zh: 实时更新：币安在63亿美元黑客事件中发现更多入侵点
updates.title_en: Live updates: Binance uncovers more breach points in $6.3B hack
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安调查发现除最初指向的工程师笔记本电脑外还有更多入侵点；联合CEO Richard Teng 表示这不是单一“一键式”操作，未将责任归咎于任何个人；存款正常运行，提现仍暂停并预计约48小时内恢复；分析人士将攻击归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor，并称被盗资金与 Bitget 事件资金在同一地址混同。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance's investigation uncovered additional breach points beyond the initially cited engineer laptop; co-CEO Richard Teng said the incident was not a single 'one-click' action and did not attribute responsibility to any individual; deposits remain normal while withdrawals are paused and expected to resume within about 48 hours; analysts attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor and said stolen funds were commingled with Bitget exploit funds in the same address.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；初步指向DevOps工程师笔记本电脑被入侵，但已发现更多入侵点，且并非单一“一键式”操作。约30亿美元资产已冻结，存款正常，提现暂停并预计约48小时内恢复。分析人士将攻击归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor，部分被盗资金与 Bitget 事件资金混同；损失将由 SAFU 和公司资金覆盖。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; preliminary findings pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer laptop, but additional breach points have been found and the incident was not a single 'one-click' action. About $3B in assets has been frozen, deposits are operating normally, and withdrawals are paused with resumption expected within about 48 hours. Analysts attribute the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor, some stolen funds were commingled with Bitget exploit funds, and losses will be covered by SAFU and company funds.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance disclosed an estimated $6.3 billion hack, reported about $3 billion in stolen assets already frozen across stablecoins, tokenized gold and ETH derivatives, said deposits remain operational with withdrawals expected to resume within 48 hours, and identified additional breach points while analysts attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance disclosed an estimated $6.3 billion hack, reported about $3 billion in stolen assets already frozen across stablecoins, tokenized gold and ETH derivatives, said deposits remain operational with withdrawals expected to resume within 48 hours, and identified additional breach points while analysts attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.

updates.title_zh: 【Aave 分阶段解冻前将下调借款上限，防止币安被盗事件攻击者建立大额仓位】
updates.title_en: 【Aave 分阶段解冻前将下调借款上限，防止币安被盗事件攻击者建立大额仓位】
updates.what_changed_zh: LlamaRisk 宣布将在 Aave V3 和 V4 分阶段解冻前，通过 Risk Steward 下调约 38 亿美元闲置借款上限，以防止币安被盗事件攻击者在解冻后的最初区块利用剩余额度建立大额仓位；其中 Aave V3 Core 的 WETH 借款上限拟从 240 万枚降至 179 万枚，USDT 从 30.9 亿枚降至 25.6 亿枚。
updates.what_changed_en: LlamaRisk announced it will use the Risk Steward to cut roughly $3.8B of idle borrow caps across Aave V3 and V4 before phased unfreezing, aiming to prevent the Binance-hack attacker from opening large positions in the first blocks after unfreezing; Aave V3 Core's WETH borrow cap is set to drop from 2.4M to 1.79M and USDT from 3.09B to 2.56B.
updates.current_state_zh: Aave V3 和 V4 储备仍因币安被盗事件处于冻结状态；LlamaRisk 已宣布在分阶段解冻前实施约 38 亿美元的借款上限下调计划，攻击者此前已在 Aave V3 Core 借出 19,762 枚 WETH。币安约 63 亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中，约 30 亿美元资产已冻结，提现暂停并预计约 48 小时内恢复。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: LlamaRisk will cut roughly $3.8B of idle borrow caps across Aave V3 and V4 via the Risk Steward before reserves are gradually unfrozen, aiming to stop the Binance-hack attacker from opening large positions in the first blocks after unfreezing.
updates.detailed_summary_en: LlamaRisk will cut roughly $3.8B of idle borrow caps across Aave V3 and V4 via the Risk Steward before reserves are gradually unfrozen, aiming to stop the Binance-hack attacker from opening large positions in the first blocks after unfreezing.

updates.what_changed_en: Blockchain analytics traced 18,270 BTC (about $1.4B) across 19 attacker-linked addresses, exceeding Coinbase's combined 18,071 BTC investment and operational holdings as of Sept. 30; the same attacker cluster held 508,621 ETH, including 200,630 ETH initially stolen and the rest accumulated by swapping stolen stablecoins and other tokens.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；确认存在多个入侵点，约30亿美元资产已冻结，损失将由公司承担；分析人士归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor。最新链上分析显示攻击者关联地址持有18,270枚BTC和508,621枚ETH。

New onchain analysis shows attacker-linked addresses holding 18,270 BTC and 508,621 ETH.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance confirmed a $6.3 billion hack, and blockchain analytics showed attacker-linked addresses holding 18,270 BTC—more than Coinbase’s reported corporate Bitcoin treasury—plus over 500,000 ETH.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance confirmed a $6.3 billion hack, and blockchain analytics showed attacker-linked addresses holding 18,270 BTC—more than Coinbase’s reported corporate Bitcoin treasury—plus over 500,000 ETH.

updates.title_zh: EIP-7702并未导致币安被黑，但可能放大了损失
updates.title_en: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
updates.what_changed_zh: Blockaid 分析指出，币安黑客事件的根本原因是签名系统被入侵，EIP-7702 可能帮助攻击者绕过安全检查并在单次交易中清空钱包，但并非攻击的必要条件。
updates.what_changed_en: Blockaid analysis indicated that compromised signing systems were the root cause of the Binance hack, and EIP-7702 may have helped attackers bypass security checks and drain wallets in a single sweep, though it was not necessary for the attack.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；确认存在多个入侵点，约30亿美元资产已冻结，损失将由公司承担；分析人士归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor。最新链上分析显示攻击者关联地址持有18,270枚BTC和508,621枚ETH。安全公司 Blockaid 指出签名系统被入侵是根本原因，EIP-7702 可能放大了损失但并非必要条件。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; multiple breach points have been confirmed, about $3B in assets has been frozen, losses will be covered by the company, and analysts attribute the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor. New onchain analysis shows attacker-linked addresses holding 18,270 BTC and 508,621 ETH. Security firm Blockaid indicated that compromised signing systems were the root cause, and EIP-7702 may have amplified losses but was not necessary.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance confirmed a $6.3 billion hack — the largest in crypto history — and pledged to cover losses, while Blockaid said compromised signing systems were the root cause and that Ethereum's EIP-7702 upgrade may have helped attackers bypass security checks and drain wallets in a single sweep.

updates.what_changed_zh: 币安确认正与 FBI 及其他执法机构合作追回被盗资产，并称行业伙伴已冻结约30亿美元；公司已预留超过63.4亿美元自有资金，其中50亿美元为被盗的同种代币。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance confirmed it is working with the FBI and other law enforcement to recover stolen assets, saying industry partners have frozen about $3 billion and that it has reserved over $6.34 billion in company funds, $5 billion of which is in the exact stolen tokens.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；确认存在多个入侵点，约30亿美元资产已冻结，损失将由公司承担；币安已预留超过63.4亿美元公司资金用于覆盖损失，其中50亿美元为受影响代币，其余将通过市场和OTC渠道购买，并将通过储备证明验证用户资产；币安正与 FBI 及其他执法机构合作追回被冻结及被盗资产；分析人士归因于朝鲜 TraderTraitor。最新链上分析显示攻击者关联地址持有18,270枚BTC和508,621枚ETH。安全公司 Blockaid 指出签名系统被入侵是根本原因，EIP-7702 可能放大了损失但并非必要条件。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; multiple breach points have been confirmed, about $3B in assets has been frozen, and losses will be covered by the company. Binance has reserved over $6.34B in company funds to cover losses, including $5B in affected tokens, is buying the remainder through market and OTC channels, and will verify user assets via Proof of Reserves. Binance is working with the FBI and other law enforcement to recover frozen and stolen assets. Analysts attribute the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor. New onchain analysis shows attacker-linked addresses holding 18,270 BTC and 508,621 ETH. Security firm Blockaid indicated that compromised signing systems were the root cause, and EIP-7702 may have amplified losses but was not necessary.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance confirmed it is working with the FBI and other law enforcement to recover stolen assets after a record $6.3 billion exploit, saying $3 billion has already been frozen by industry partners and that it has reserved more than $6.34 billion of company funds — $5 billion of it in the exact tokens taken — to cover the shortfall.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance confirmed it is working with the FBI and other law enforcement to recover stolen assets after a record $6.3 billion exploit, saying $3 billion has already been frozen by industry partners and that it has reserved more than $6.34 billion of company funds — $5 billion of it in the exact tokens taken — to cover the shortfall.

updates.title_zh: 【币安联席 CEO：将于下周一前公布完整储备金证明】
updates.title_en: 【币安联席 CEO：将于下周一前公布完整储备金证明】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安联席 CEO Richard Teng 表示，币安将在下周一前发布完整储备金证明报告，并可能先发布初步版本；用户提现仍按原计划有望在周日前恢复。他还披露攻击者利用 EIP-7702 获取对一个热钱包的链上执行授权，绕过常规审批流程，并发现更多入侵点及自毁机制。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said Binance will release a complete proof-of-reserves report by Monday, possibly with an initial version beforehand, and user withdrawals remain expected to resume by Sunday. He also disclosed that attackers used EIP-7702 to gain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, bypassing normal approval processes, and that additional breach points and self-destruct mechanisms were found.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安约63亿美元黑客事件仍在调查中；币安联席 CEO Richard Teng 表示将在下周一前公布完整储备金证明，并有望在周日前恢复用户提现；攻击者利用 EIP-7702 获取热钱包链上执行授权，调查发现更多入侵点及自毁机制；币安已预留超过63.4亿美元公司资金覆盖损失，其中50亿美元为受影响同类代币，正通过市场和OTC渠道购入剩余部分，并与执法机构合作追回资产。
updates.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said a complete proof-of-reserves report will be released by Monday and user withdrawals are expected to resume by Sunday; attackers used EIP-7702 to obtain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, and additional breach points and self-destruct mechanisms were found. Binance has reserved over $6.34B in company funds to cover losses, including $5B in affected tokens, is buying the remainder through market and OTC channels, and is working with law enforcement to recover assets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says the exchange will release a complete proof-of-reserves report by Monday and restore withdrawals by Sunday, after attackers used EIP-7702 to gain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, with more than $6.34B in corporate funds set aside to fully cover losses.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says the exchange will release a complete proof-of-reserves report by Monday and restore withdrawals by Sunday, after attackers used EIP-7702 to gain on-chain execution authorization over a hot wallet, with more than $6.34B in corporate funds set aside to fully cover losses.
